4372b717ece66dec4580740d1e43b840fe943e36.summary: Flashpoint reports a new FIN7-linked attack panel called Astra, plus SQLRat and DNSbot malware, in campaigns it dates to May to July 2018, possibly back to January 2018. Lures were phishing emails with malicious documents. The samples use scheduled tasks for persistence and DNS-based command channels. The report cites DoJ indictments for the Combi Security front company and for FIN7 theft of more than 15 million payment card records from US businesses. The FIN7 link is the report's own linking, not a confirmed finding.

434bafb13939fd216b92c8e7c67539e3f9caac7f.summary: Cynet's Orion team reports active exploitation of the Log4Shell flaws (CVE-2021-44228 and CVE-2021-45046) against VMware Horizon servers from early January 2022. Attackers used the Horizon Tomcat service to deploy Cobalt Strike beacons, XMRig cryptominers and PowerShell-based reverse shells, and abused a VMware node.exe binary as a LOLBin. The report links some activity to Night Sky ransomware (tracked by Microsoft as DEV-0401) and possibly Memento ransomware, with hedged attribution. Indicators of compromise are omitted here.
